drafts.subject: Re: Guest post on jaseci.org - I'll pay $150
drafts.message:
Hi Jessica,

Thanks for reaching out and for your interest in contributing to jaseci.org.

Unfortunately, we don't accept paid guest posts or sponsored content with dofollow links. As an open-source project, our content is primarily focused on our own educational and community resources, and we aim to keep all external links in our content editorial and non-commercial in nature.

That said, if you or your team have genuine expertise in areas relevant to our community — AI development, programming, open-source tooling, or related topics — and you'd like to contribute a guest post organically (no payment involved), we'd be happy to review it. In that case, we can include one nofollow link in the author bio. Content would need to meet our editorial standards and align with the interests of our developer community.

If that's something you'd be interested in, just let me know and I can share our content guidelines and submission process.

Best,
Jaseci Team
impact@jaseci.org
